entries.2a4c9070f85fb51b: Under its management policy of Back to Basics, the company is working to create appealing products and narrow down its menu, rebuild QSC at all stores, and provide a safe and secure dining environment. The medium-term management plan has been revised to cover the fiscal years ending March 2027 to March 2029, and the company plans to secure production and supply capacity through new store openings, store renovations, longer operating hours at roadside stores, and construction of a new Koriyama plant (scheduled to begin operation in December 2028).

In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the company sold 22 seasonal limited products in total.
entries.884a0412c163d2fb: The company is headquartered in Kōriyama, Fukushima Prefecture, and operates a restaurant business through a chain of ramen shops. In October 2024, it absorbed its wholly owned subsidiary KOURAKUEN CORPORATION through an absorption merger and became an operating company; it has no consolidated subsidiaries. As of March 31, 2026, the number of employees was 581, and the company is listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
